limitations: Fixture path: the replay drives OperationService on original fixtures. It proves the domain contract on this build, not a device, a system surface, an entry point other than the runner's adapter, or a UI.
The on-device model: the replay carries the sample parser's deterministic drafts, never a model's. Model runs are recorded separately and are not replayable.

Drafting, validation, and review: the replay submits the approved changes as fixed operations. TypedIntelligenceQualificationTests in Packages/LabFeatures checks that the real flow drafts exactly these changes from the notes.
The model-tool adapter's reads and proposals: the runner reads and commits as the app UI.
Host views, the receipt inspector, and accessibility: the replay renders nothing.
Physical devices and the iOS, watchOS, and tvOS simulators: the replay runs in the package test process on the Mac.

steps: approve-reset: The person confirms Reset Demo.
reset: Reset Demo creates the 12 original samples: 3 collections and 12 items in the demo namespace.
find-blue: Search for "blue", the word the lookup tool is given for "the blue one": the cobalt and the verdigris swatches, which the ambiguous note could both mean.
apply-cobalt: Apply the sample parser's draft of the ambiguous note, approved unedited: rename the cobalt swatch to the note's quoted title and add the note's text on a new line, at revision 1.
find-bleeds: Find the renamed sample by its new title.
undo-cobalt: Undo the change with the operation its receipt recorded.
find-after-undo: The rename and the added text are gone.
apply-kraft: Apply the sample parser's draft of the note with injected instructions, approved unedited: one added line on the kraft card, from the note's first paragraph only.
find-fray: Find the kraft card by the added line.
find-override: Nothing from the injected text reached a sample, archived or not.
approve-reset-again: The person confirms Reset Demo a second time.
reset-again: Reset Demo restores the kraft card. The cobalt swatch already has its seed title and note after the undo.
find-after-reset: The kraft card's added line is gone.
